text.en:
Customer Service — Hanbros UK

Our customer service team is the backbone of Hanbros UK's reputation as the leading UK to Turkey shipping company. Every enquiry — from a first-time parcel sender to a regular commercial client — receives clear, honest and timely support.

How We Support You

  • Pre-shipment advice — what you can send, packing tips and document checklists.
  • Quote assistance — help completing forms and understanding pricing.
  • Shipment tracking — status updates at every milestone.
  • Issue resolution — proactive communication if delays or queries arise.
  • After-delivery follow-up — ensuring your goods arrived safely.

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I contact customer service?

Phone, email, WhatsApp and our online contact form — bilingual English and Turkish support.

What are your response times?

We aim to respond to all enquiries within one working day; urgent tracking requests are handled same day.

Hanbros UK — customer service that matches our logistics excellence.
